definitions.short: a sheath ; figuratively, the body (as the receptacle of the soul)
definitions.full: H5085. nidneh [ גין ] with בְּגִין בְּ, preposition on account of (so Galilean Aramaic, D § 47, 3 ), read perhaps in Dan 7:15 : see נִדְגֵה . נִדְנֵ֑ה (Masora Baer) noun [masculine] sheath ( לְדָן נְדָן, ᵑ7 ; see Biblical Hebrew (late) נָדָן , Persian loan-word); — ׳בְּ֗֗֗נ Dan 7:15 my spirit in (its) sheath , i.e. my body; < נִדְנָה emphatic, or suffix נִדְנַהּ (K § 54, 3. β )); or (Nö GGA. 1884, 1022 Bev) נְדָנַהּ ; but expression at best strange; read probably דְּנָה בְּגִין on account of this ( בְּגִין as ᵑ7 J ; D § 47. 3 (2nd ed. 47. 10) ), M 72* compare Buhl Dr.
